note: Commonsense intents. Each entry: the phrase a human reads, the picture a human pictures (requires), a GOOD implementation and the BAD literal reading an agent produces without this table. Checked by scripts/qa_commonsense.ts. See references/11-commonsense-intents.md.

entries.good: hips on the chair seat, torso behind the desk edge, hands on the keyboard, feet on the floor
entries.bad: a stickman seated on the floor beside an empty chair, desk off to the side

entries.good: hips on the couch cushion, back against the backrest, feet on the floor
entries.bad: standing in front of the couch, or sitting on the floor in front of it

entries.good: body horizontal on the mattress, head on the pillow
entries.bad: body horizontal on the floor next to the bed

entries.good: the window clearly in frame, the character beside it, turned toward it, light falling from it onto the face
entries.bad: character standing in the middle of the room with no window in frame

entries.good: a bedroom (different from the previous shot), a bed with mattress + pillow + blanket, body on the mattress, eyes closed, dim light, an establishing shot or a cut on a door proving the change of room
entries.bad: the same background as the previous room, a man lying on the bare floor while the bed stands in the corner

entries.good: the kitchen background: counters, cabinets, fridge visible behind the character
entries.bad: the office or void background reused because the shot was already staged

entries.good: a room interior that is not the ground-floor scene, with a bed or furniture that reads as a private room
entries.bad: the same street or office background as the shot before, unchanged

entries.good: the door in frame (closed, opening, or ajar), the character beside it, the door's state matching the sentence
entries.bad: a character gesturing at empty wall space where a door should be

entries.good: the car body in frame, the driver seated inside it (body behind the car body, head and shoulders visible), hands on the steering wheel
entries.bad: a stickman standing next to a car, or seated in the air in front of it

entries.good: the box drawn around the object, the object partly or fully inside it, lid state matching the sentence
entries.bad: the object floating beside a closed box

entries.good: the blanket drawn over the torso, head above the edge, body on the mattress
entries.bad: the blanket drawn below the body, or the character on the floor under nothing

entries.good: water surface at the character's waist or chest, ripples at the waterline, water background
entries.bad: a character standing on dry grass talking about water

entries.good: the cup in the hand, fingers overlapping the handle, cup moving with the arm, cup sized to the hand
entries.bad: the cup floating a hand's width away from the palm

entries.good: the box in both arms in front of the chest, arms bent around it, body leaning back a little under the weight
entries.bad: a box beside the character with empty hands

entries.good: two characters facing each other, the money moving from one hand to the other at the spoken word
entries.bad: money floating between two characters who never reach for it

entries.good: the rope in frame, both hands wrapped around it, the body leaning away from the pull
entries.bad: a rope hanging behind a character whose hands are empty

entries.good: hands at keyboard height, fingers moving, screen visible, eyes toward the screen
entries.bad: the character standing with arms down while the narration says typing

entries.good: the book open in both hands at chest height, head tilted down toward it
entries.bad: a closed book on a table and a character looking at the camera

entries.good: the phone at the ear, hand raised to the head, mouth animated for the line
entries.bad: a phone lying on the desk and a character talking to nobody

entries.good: the kitchen background, a pan or plate in hand, arms working over the counter
entries.bad: an empty void background with a character miming stirring

entries.good: the door drawn ajar or open, a gap showing what is beyond, the handle on the side the character reaches
entries.bad: a closed door while the narration says it opens

entries.good: the lamp in frame with its light state matching the sentence, the room grade following it
entries.bad: a pitch-black frame with no lamp to explain it

entries.good: the chair (or bench/sofa, whatever the seat is) visible and unoccupied, framed so the emptiness is the subject
entries.bad: a character seated in the 'empty' chair

entries.good: cracks or flying pieces on the object, the object's silhouette visibly damaged
entries.bad: an intact object while the narration says it broke

entries.good: rain layer over the scene, wet ground reflections, a darker grade, characters under cover or reacting
entries.bad: dry ground, bright grade, nobody reacting, while rain is described

entries.good: an interior with the window in frame, rain drawn on the glass, the character looking at it
entries.bad: rain falling inside the room, or a windowless wall

entries.good: falling snow, cold blue-grey grade, breath or coats if the character is outside
entries.bad: a warm sunny palette with no snow

entries.good: night grade, moon or lamp as the light source, windows reading dark outside
entries.bad: a bright noon sky while the narration says night

entries.good: the run pose with speedlines, leaning forward, feet off the ground on some frames
entries.bad: a standing stickman sliding sideways

entries.good: walk pose, moving toward the frame edge, an exit beat or a cut on the door
entries.bad: the character standing still while the narration says he leaves

entries.good: a street background, the red light visible as a signal (a `sign` prop with a red label), the vehicle stopped
entries.bad: a car driving through a street with no signal anywhere in frame

entries.good: the fall pose, tilted body, ground contact by the end of the shot
entries.bad: an upright stickman standing calmly while the narration says he falls

entries.good: two distinct characters with different colours/builds, both in frame
entries.bad: one character drawn twice by accident, or only one on screen

entries.good: at least four figures at different depths and sizes, filling the background
entries.bad: two people standing in an empty street called a crowd

entries.good: the giant scaled up so their head leaves the normal frame, normal characters tiny beside them
entries.bad: a normal-sized character described as a giant

entries.good: three distinct props with visible spacing, counted in one glance
entries.bad: one prop while the narration counts three

entries.good: two actors facing each other at conversational distance, only the speaker's mouth moving, listener reacting
entries.bad: two actors both facing the camera, or one actor talking to empty space

entries.good: two actors facing each other, angry faces, wide gestures, tighter framing
entries.bad: two calm neutral faces while the narration says they argue

entries.good: the two bodies close, arms around each other, heads tilted together
entries.bad: two characters standing a metre apart with arms down

entries.good: two actors facing each other, right hands meeting in the middle, eye contact
entries.bad: two actors facing the camera with hands at their sides

entries.good: half-closed eyes, slumped shoulders, slow breathing
entries.bad: a bright smiling face while the narration says tired

entries.good: brows down and in, narrowed eyes, clenched hands, wider stance
entries.bad: a neutral face with the word 'angry' in the narration

entries.good: wide round eyes, small open mouth, body pulled back, an exclaim mark
entries.bad: the same neutral face held through the reveal

entries.good: raised brows, sweat drop, body leaning away, hands up
entries.bad: a relaxed posture in a scene the narration calls terrifying

entries.good: an empty room, doors open onto nothing, a lamp still on to show it is lived in
entries.bad: a character standing in the middle of the 'empty' house

entries.good: the empty seat centred and clearly unoccupied
entries.bad: the chair hidden behind a character, or occupied

entries.good: one still figure, camera moves instead of the character, held frame
entries.bad: a walk cycle while the narration says he did not move

entries.good: a before/after split or a labelled timeline insert so the contrast is drawn
entries.bad: two unrelated shots with nothing marking the change

entries.good: the hand on the button at the spoken word, then the effect in the next shot
entries.bad: a character miming a press at empty air

entries.good: the room grade drops to dark at the beat, a lamp or bulb visible and dead
entries.bad: the scene stays bright while the narration says everything went dark

entries.good: a flash or iris into a differently graded past scene, sepia or desaturated
entries.bad: a hard cut into an identically graded scene with no signal it is the past

entries.good: the cause and the effect are separate shots, with a match cut or a shared object linking them
entries.bad: cause and effect crammed into one shot with an arrow pointing at nothing

entries.good: the abstraction drawn as an insert graphic: labelled diagram, comparison board or counter
entries.bad: the narrator says 'imagine' and the screen shows an unchanged character

entries.good: an animated bar/line chart or a counting-up number, labelled and legible in one second
entries.bad: a character gesturing at empty space while the narration says 'the numbers'

entries.good: labelled parts, arrows between them, revealed in time with the narration
entries.bad: talking head only, with the explanation left entirely to the voice

entries.good: the metaphor drawn literally (traffic as cars, bandwidth as a pipe) with the comparison labelled
entries.bad: the metaphor spoken but never shown
